facts.text: The Catholic Promise Scholarship awards $25,000 annually ($100,000 over four years) to qualifying graduates of accredited Catholic high schools with at least a 3.0 unweighted GPA.

sources.title: Scholarships and Grants | University of Saint Joseph CT
sources.quote: The Catholic Promise Scholarship is awarded to eligible students from a regionally accredited Catholic high school who earn a 3.0 unweighted GPA or higher after completing three years at, and graduating from, a Catholic high school.

sources.title: Scholarships and Grants | University of Saint Joseph CT
sources.quote: The scholarship is $25,000 per year, and is renewable for four consecutive years (up to eight semesters) for a total undergraduate scholarship amount of $100,000.
